mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in FEDFUNDS above 5% for three consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 70% of triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 of more than 2% indicates a significant weakening in aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in UNRATE above 4.5% for two consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and inflation, prompting the Fed to raise rates and resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in INDPRO of more than 0.5% for three consecutive months indicates weakening industrial production, reducing corporate earnings and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < previous month and < previous month - 0.5% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly increase in HOUST and a decrease in RSAFS signals rising housing demand with constrained supply, which boosts homebuilding equities but may raise inflation concerns, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > previous month AND RSAFS < previous month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +0.5%) in at least 55% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in PAYEMS and a fall in UNRATE over two months indicates strong job creation with stable unemployment, suggesting healthy economic expansion and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > previous month AND UNRATE == previous month for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +1%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp one-month drop in FEDFUNDS below 3% during a recession signals an aggressive easing cycle, which boosts risk asset valuations and results in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +1.5%) in at least 50% of triggered recession episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly increase in GDPC1 above 0.4% for four consecutive months signals a robust demand recovery, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of regime.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered periods.
